routes.name: full_f32_online_tile1024
routes.design: One local1024 workgroup per KV head and K1024 split computes all six QK rows, online softmax state, and all 6x128 unnormalized PV outputs; a second kernel merges F32 split partials.

quality.scope: global layers 0/4/8/12/16/20/24 at 16K over 127 recurrent transitions

routes.decision: reject because cross-split F32 association crosses Laguna BF16 boundaries and compounds recurrently

routes.name: chronological_scalar_pv_layer24
routes.design: Preserve the chronological scalar-F32 PV chain inside each split and scope the route to only global layer 24.
routes.decision: reject because exact intra-split PV does not remove cross-split softmax/merge association drift

routes.name: f32_downstream_handoff_layer24
routes.design: Keep the attention gate result in F32 through the downstream source-F16 projection seam instead of rounding at the retained BF16 boundary.
routes.decision: reject because changing the model's admitted BF16 boundary worsens trajectory quality

routes.name: exact_boundary_repair
routes.design: Use the exact raw score plane and denominator, flag BF16-boundary-ambiguous outputs, and replay their chronological scalar-F32 PV chains.
routes.decision: reject because sparse O(context) replay is slower than the retained exact attention core

routes.name: cooperative_bf16_wmma_k128_k512
routes.design: Use cooperative BF16 matrix terms for QK/PV with K128 or K512 online split ownership, then merge compact numerator/state records.
routes.decision: reject before model quality because conversion, state, and merge overhead lose 3.7-4.9x
